Two more items from the Degen coordinator (2026-11-09). Queue each as a roadmap step or debt with its incident, or fix it if small:

1. Waiting-page pictures are too small. Owner, 2026-11-09 20:47 CST: "the images are so small in the artifact cockpit." Mailaudit triage's read, not yet checked: in the waiting-page template (skills/waiting-page, page.html), optPic passes maxH 480 to fitFrame and never scales above 1x, so a 390x844 phone mockup draws about 220 px wide and a two-page Duo mockup shrinks to card width. Check that read against page.html, then fix it so a mockup fills its card width (raise the cap, or let the picture scale above 1x), and show it at phone and desktop widths, light and dark.

2. The merge tool cannot record a chain of fix checks. `merge --review-record --fix-check` refuses a second fix-check line ("the reviewed head must be the head of the newest record, and that record must have no fix-check line"), so a second small fix after a fix check has no record form, and the PR reads as stale. Incident: Degen PR 577, head d86c122, 2026-11-09 20:31 CST; worked around with a fresh full review.

Also: claude-settings has no triage or coordinator session. Notes like item 1 bounce between other repos' sessions. Consider keeping this session as claude-settings' coordinator, or say which session owns claude-settings intake.
